name: MiniFlix FL-04 MCP Agent Manifest
description: Local MCP manifest for the MiniFlix FL-04 repository, exposing repository tools, documentation resources, prompts, and agent tasks.

tools.description: Read file contents from the repository root. Use only safe paths under the project directory.
Search repository documentation and source files for keywords, patterns, or configuration references.
Check the MCP server status and uptime.

resources.description: Project assignment and workflow documentation under docs/assignments.
Node helper that generates study notes templates from workflow/study-notes-inputs.json.
Project README with setup, environment, and MCP instructions.

prompts.description: Inspect the repository and determine whether the current FL-04 submission is a workflow, an agent, or both.
prompts.example: Review the repository structure, docs, and scripts. Tell me if FL-04 is currently a workflow or an agent and why.

prompts.description: Create a concrete agent upgrade proposal for FL-04 using the available MCP tools and resources.
prompts.example: Using the repo_file_reader and assignment_docs resources, describe an agent that can audit forms, run checks, and update documentation.

prompts.description: Produce a screenshot/evidence checklist for deployment and MCP server verification.
prompts.example: List the exact screens and outputs someone should capture while running the project and the MCP server.

tasks.title: Verify current workflow status and manifest metadata
tasks.description: Use repo_file_reader to inspect project files and confirm whether FL-04 is a workflow or agent.

tasks.title: Update the README with MCP integration and commands
tasks.description: Use assignment_docs resource and repo_search to add setup and server commands without breaking the existing app.
